The PKGBUILD contains no malicious code, command substitutions, or suspicious network requests. The disagreement was caused by an API error in the qwen model, not a security concern.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model experienced an HTTP 400 BadRequestError when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD, leading to an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited the PKGBUILD and correctly identified it as a standard, safe binary package with no malicious behavior.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: API errors during critical file audits (like PKGBUILD) should trigger automatic retries or fallback mechanisms to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts.
Models correctly recognize standard '-bin' packaging patterns where upstream artifacts are pinned with checksums and installed to standard directories.
